name: Rockets
tagline: Catch stars in a dark sky. One link puts a friend in it with you.
description:
You are a little rocket in a field of stars. Fly, catch them, score. On your own it is you against the clock — a minute of sky, then your best lives in the file, ready for the next round.

Send the invite and a friend lands in the same sky. Live scores, the same stars, a bump if you cross. There is no game server, no account, no lobby. The room is the link.

On a phone, a thumb anywhere is the stick. On a laptop, arrows, WASD, or point the mouse.

An unofficial port of Rocket Universe by lauthieb. The original needs a game server. This copy does not: the sky lives in the room.
